failure_policy: Stop on the first failure and preserve every contact. No retry, no scoring, no partial quality read. A failed smoke stops the cell and the Thinking arm does not open. A smoke is re-flown whole at most once under one root-diagnosed recovery re-registration.

generation_budget.definition: The direct-only phase program (configs/policy/phase-direct-only-v1.json: one phase, max_contacts 1, always-run-full-program) makes exactly ONE contact per row, so 4 x 1 = 4 is the program's exact maximum; the plan ceiling adds 1 answer-only fallback contact per row (one per budgeted-thinking contact, core.reasoning_knobs): 8 = 4 x 2. The live phase fit (core.preparation_fit.build_direct_only_raw_fit_gate) makes 4 x 1 x 1 = 4 tokenizer endpoint calls under its own run id SAEA-SLURP-DIRECT-ONLY-FOLD-B-SMOKE-4-FIT-NPU-PORT-V1. The accelerator bound is PROVISIONAL NPU card-hours = 0.5 h wall-clock allowance x instances x T (every held card), from PORT_DEPLOYMENT_PROFILE (pending; filled from the measured speed sweep); it is PROVISIONAL, a BOUND never a target, and planned_gpu_hours (0.5) is the 266-E figure kept only as the numeric placeholder the plan field requires until the sweep re-derives it. Budgets are run-cumulative across every attempt of a run id.

Served by the BF16 / vLLM-Ascend Thinking core (bf16-thinking-vllm-slurp-module-fold-b-seq4-len24k-budget3072-max4096-port-v1; per-sequence window 24,576 tokens; deployment PORT_DEPLOYMENT_PROFILE (pending; filled from the measured speed sweep)) over the original recordings (native-raw-speech-query-prefix-v1); declared differences (design doc section 8): 8.1 BF16 weights instead of GGUF Q4_K_M; BF16 KV instead of q8_0; 8.2 audio features computed by the server's audio tower from the raw audio instead of llama.cpp mmproj packets; 8.3 vLLM sampling and kernels: temperature 0 with a fixed seed is deterministic per server build, not bit-identical to llama.cpp; 8.5 forced-close whitespace (vLLM reasoning_end_str) until verified; D1 reasoning budget 3072 with forced close and one answer-only fallback instead of the historical 8,192-token uncapped completion (36 of 1,080 266-E rows ran to the cap). Read beside the 266-E Thinking arm, never as a byte replay of it.
